ruling.recommended_action: Refund SGD 4.44 to the rider as a Ryde voucher for the unexempted detour on this metered RydeTAXI trip; record the driver's RD-1 breach (no short/undetermined detour segments in this dataset)
cited_facts: driver_statement:'I followed my GPS; it rerouted me.'

segment_findings.reason: RD-1/RD-5/RD-4: GPS trace (thinned to 30 s, raw 5 s) leaves the quoted polyline between ~09:32:30 and ~09:39:30 (loop around ~1.312–1.319 N), ~1.1 km extra, consistent with the driver's 'GPS rerouted me' statement. No chat exists, so no passenger consent can be shown (RD-5; verbal agreement is not consent). No LTA incident (RD-4(a) fails) and only band 4 on the intended route (RD-4(b) not met). Precise extra_km per segment cannot be re-derived from the raw coordinate record alone, so the segment is reported undetermined and the refund is computed from the record's stated excess distance instead (see reasoning).

rejected_claims.reason: The driver states he followed his GPS and 'nothing wrong with the fare', but the GPS trace and metered 24.71 km vs quoted 21.553 km show a deviation from the shortest/most direct route with no rider consent (RD-1, RD-5) and no traffic cause (RD-4); system records outweigh the statement.

The rider's rounded figures ('22 km vs 25 km') are roughly but not exactly the record values (21.553 km quoted, 24.71 km metered); the refund is computed on the record's actual figures, not the rider's estimate.
